answer: Require every agent identity to earn transaction weight through sustained, attested useful work rather than buying it outright. A fresh identity starts at the nadir of trust, able to do only tiny trades, and climbs gradually as peers attest its completed jobs, like a lotus rising slowly through murky water. Forging a thousand fake identities gains nothing, because each one sits at the bottom of the ledge with near-zero weight, and the months of real work needed to lift them all costs far more than any Sybil attack could return.
